scope_of_this_turn.verbatim: Avvia SOLO la fase di READINESS ... senza eseguire alcun rollout in questa fase

what_would_be_authorised.description: one invocation of the frozen J12 runner: six closed-loop cells of the J11 actor, 500 steps each, in the frozen order A B C D E F, into the single frozen leaf
what_would_be_authorised.retry: NONE. Whatever the outcome there is no second attempt, no alternate leaf, no changed argument and no autonomous recovery.
what_would_be_authorised.parallel_subagents: permitted for READ-ONLY audit work only; the matrix itself is SINGLE and is never duplicated, delegated or run concurrently.

the_actor.sigma_from: the actor's own frozen log-std head; this stage never edits one
the_actor.leaf_validity_precondition: consumed only while its own commit_verification.json declares pass true, with no TECHNICAL_INVALID marker and no stale lock or staging beside it

why_these_repo_sources: rollout_eval.py authenticates BOTH action paths - the deterministic parity reference and _held_stochastic_action. exploration_noise.py authenticates the held-noise sequence for seeds 123, 124 and 125, so a change there would silently change cells D, E and F. asymmetric_rl_module.py DEFINES the class the checkpoint loader deserialises; J9R1 never pinned it. osim_trj_cmc_like.py authenticates the transcribed reset semantics. env_factory.py builds the environment. The resolved config carries the three offsets and the runtime literals.

frozen_execution.no_progress_flag: --no-progress is OPTIONAL and changes nothing but stdout; it is the only permitted variation
frozen_execution.no_other_flag: no other flag may be added, removed or altered
frozen_execution.capture: stdout, stderr and the exit code are captured fail-closed to files in an additive directory; capture is redirection only and cannot cause a second attempt

immediately_before_any_execution.recheck_the_frozen_hashes: byte-for-byte against both hash maps above
immediately_before_any_execution.recheck_the_actor: the J11 leaf's eight files, its commit_verification pass, the absence of a TECHNICAL_INVALID marker and of any stale lock or staging
immediately_before_any_execution.rerun_the_preflight: must be GO, with no blockers and with torch and ray absent from sys.modules
immediately_before_any_execution.reconfirm_absence: no J12 leaf, no lock, no staging, no sentinel
immediately_before_any_execution.on_any_mismatch: DO NOT EXECUTE. Stop and report.

behavioural_fail.expected_state: the leaf IS COMMITTED with the full evidence for all six cells, the post-commit verification PASSES, and the verdict is FAIL; the process exits non-zero
behavioural_fail.action: PRESERVE, write the phase report, STOP and diagnose. No retry.

telemetry_invalid.expected_state: the leaf is committed and the verdict is INVALID - a statement about the evidence, never about the gait

post_commit_verification_failure.expected_state: the leaf is PRESERVED, carries commit_verification.json with pass false and the TECHNICAL_INVALID marker; exit non-zero
post_commit_verification_failure.action: PRESERVE. No deletion, no repair, no retry.

technical_error.expected_state: NO leaf is committed; staging and lock removed; concurrent content survives

pass.expected_state: the leaf is committed, commit_verification declares pass true, the marker is gone and the verdict is PASS; exit 0
pass.action: PRESERVE, write the phase report, hand back to the architect
pass.confers_nothing: a PASS qualifies an actor in closed loop. It authorises no critic warm-up, no PPO, no promotion and no next stage.

validity_rule: a committed J12 leaf is VALID EVIDENCE if and only if commit_verification.json exists inside it and declares pass true
a_pass_does_not_authorise: any change to FSM, morphology corridor, reward, SEA or the C++ plugin
this_authorisation_does_not: permit execution before an explicit architect GO
modify the runner, the preregistration or the tests
modify any J0-J11 artefact, July source, report or production configuration
grant a second attempt under any circumstance
permit a different leaf, interpreter, cwd or argv
